column1: # Arabic Arena variant table: same-lexeme spelling variants folded at normalization level L2.
# Admission rule: the same word with the same meaning, spelled differently or written as it is
# reduced in speech. Never synonyms or dialect alternants (ايش/شو/ايه, عايز/بدي, هلق/الحين).
# Keys and values are in L1 spelling (ة->ه, ى->ي, hamza dropped). A multi-word key is replaced on
# the joined text before tokenization. Changing this file changes scores: bump VARIANTS_VERSION
# in sttarena/normalizers/variants.py and re-run the collision audit (sttarena audit variants).
# Known, documented collisions: الي (MSA "to", after L1) is folded with اللي; ميه is both "water"
# (Egyptian) and "hundred"; علي is "on", "on me" and the name Ali; كت is sometimes كانت; متين is
